hero.eyebrow: For the moments you wish were easier
hero.heading: The little things
hero.copy: That daily hassle you barely notice anymore. The routine you'd love to simplify. We believe a thoughtful find can make everyday moments feel a little lighter—and knowing if it's right for you should be simple.
hero.concept_alt: Illustrative scene of a desk organizer, smartphone and an open parcel.

principles.label: What matters to HiParcelo
principles.useful_copy: Ideas that begin with familiar, everyday frustrations.
principles.clarity_copy: A closer look is part of making a choice that feels right.
principles.help_copy: A clear place to ask when you want to know more.

discovery.heading: Imagine the easier moment.
discovery.copy: You know the feeling: you spot an idea and immediately picture where it could fit into your life. We love that moment. We also believe the practical details should make just as much sense as the idea itself.
discovery.concept_alt: Illustrative scene of a hand placing a pen in a sage-green organizer on a desk.
discovery.life_copy: A small frustration. A task that takes more effort than it should. A moment you'd like to improve.
discovery.detail_copy: A thoughtful idea can make you look at your everyday routine in a whole new way.
discovery.choice_title: And the details make it yours.
discovery.choice_copy: The fit, the intended use and the full picture help you choose without feeling rushed.
discovery.price_details: Find the available options, full costs and delivery information on the product page.

about.heading: Less noise. Better discoveries.
about.copy: There are plenty of things you could buy. We're interested in the ones worth considering. HiParcelo is taking a focused approach to practical finds: understand the problem, appreciate the possibility, and make the details easy to see before deciding.

help.label: Know what to expect and how to get help
help.delivery_copy: Delivery details, when an offer is ready.
help.contact_copy: We're here to hear what's on your mind.

faq.heading: A few things you may be wondering.
faq.copy: The answers that help you get your bearings.
faq.products_question: Can I buy the item in the photos?
faq.products_answer: The current images are brand illustrations. The first HiParcelo product hasn’t been released, so there is nothing to order or reserve yet. Its page will show the actual item when it is available.
faq.delivery_question: Is the delivery journey an arrival promise?
faq.delivery_answer: It shows the stages a parcel can pass through. The 2 + 7 + 2 days are an example, not a confirmed delivery estimate. The estimate for the actual product and destination will be shown before ordering.
faq.returns_question: Where can I check the return details?
faq.returns_answer: Our returns page explains the current position. The return window, costs, instructions and refund process for the first offer will be published before it goes on sale.
faq.help_question: Can I ask about one small detail?
faq.help_answer: Please do. The contact page is there for the measurement, delivery question or practical detail you need help with. Tell us the item and what you’d like to know.

closing.heading: A good find has a place in your day.
closing.copy: Get to know the everyday thinking behind HiParcelo.

footer.tagline: A small find. A little relief.

faq.heading: Find the detail you need.
faq.intro: A little context, a direct answer and somewhere to go next.
faq.brand_a: Useful finds for the small hassles you’ve learned to work around. We’re beginning with one focused offer, built around a recognizable everyday use.
faq.order_q: Can I order or reserve anything now?
faq.order_a: Not yet. The first find is in preparation. There is no payment, preorder or reservation option available.
faq.products_q: Are the items in the current photos for sale?
faq.products_a: The current scenes are brand illustrations. They aren’t photos of an available product, customer results or our operating warehouse. The first offer will have its own actual product information.
faq.delivery_q: Where do you deliver, and when might it arrive?
faq.delivery_a: The first destination and delivery route haven’t been confirmed. The actual offer will show available destinations, processing and delivery estimates, shipping costs and any import arrangements before orders open.
faq.returns_q: What if I change my mind or something is wrong?
faq.returns_a: The first offer’s return conditions, applicable rights, costs, return steps and refund process will be available before purchase. The returns page explains our current status and where to ask a question.
faq.tracking_q: How will I find my order updates?
faq.tracking_a: Use the order-status link in your confirmation email for the updates available for your parcel. A label can exist before the carrier receives it. If you can’t find the link, contact us.
faq.support_q: How do I ask a question?
faq.support_a: Use the contact page or email {{ email }}. Tell us the item and the detail you need. For an order question, add your order number if you have it.
faq.health_q: Can you advise whether a product is medically suitable for me?
faq.health_a: We can explain the published product information. Medical suitability is a question for a qualified clinician who knows your circumstances. Our general guides don’t replace product instructions or clinical advice.
faq.feedback_q: Where can I see customer reviews?
faq.feedback_a: There are no customer reviews to show yet because the first offer hasn’t launched.

hi_edit.hero_copy: Some hassles become so familiar, you stop looking for an easier way. That moment you find one? That’s the feeling behind HiParcelo.
hi_edit.hero_footnote: A little curiosity. A lot of possibility.
hi_edit.hero_bottom: GOOD IDEAS AREN'T ALWAYS BIG ONES
hi_edit.feeling_copy: Not a grand transformation. Just those ordinary moments when a little less clutter, a little less effort or a little more comfort would feel surprisingly good.
hi_edit.feeling_space_copy: The everyday spaces that could do with a touch more thought.
hi_edit.feeling_effort_copy: The extra step you've repeated so often you barely notice it.
hi_edit.feeling_comfort_copy: A routine you wish felt just a bit more comfortable.
hi_edit.method_head_b: Earn a place in your day.
hi_edit.method_copy: A good demonstration helps you see the possibility. A few clear details help you picture living with it. These are the questions behind our first find.
hi_edit.method_one_q: Which little hassle would this take off my hands?
hi_edit.method_one_a: Think of a moment you repeat: the awkward setup, the extra step, the search for something you just put down. The useful part should be easy to describe in a sentence.
hi_edit.method_two_a: The exact item, the option you chose, the quantity and what comes with it. If the demonstration uses an accessory that is sold separately, that belongs in the details too.
hi_edit.method_three_q: Will it work in my actual space or routine?
hi_edit.method_three_a: Size, materials, compatibility and care can decide whether a clever idea becomes something you use. Compare those details with the place and purpose you have in mind.
hi_edit.method_four_q: What can I expect after ordering?
hi_edit.method_four_a: Check delivery to your address, the full cost, the estimated arrival window and the return conditions. If one detail is holding you back, ask us about that detail.
hi_edit.method_note: We’re preparing one focused first offer around these questions.
hi_edit.manifesto_head_a: The best find isn't the one everyone wants.
hi_edit.manifesto_head_b: It's the one that makes sense to you.
hi_edit.manifesto_copy: We'd rather make it easier to understand a good idea than pressure you to decide quickly. Recognizing the need comes first. The details make the decision yours.
hi_edit.manifesto_link: More about our point of view

hi_journey.heading: The next good moment? It’s here.
hi_journey.introduction: From a decision on your screen to a parcel at your door. Follow an illustrated journey through packing, international transit and the final delivery.
hi_journey.prep_body: The illustrated parcel is protected, sealed and labelled before leaving the packing station. Preparing a parcel is part of the time between ordering and receiving.
hi_journey.flight_body: International transport, arrival and customs are separate steps. Border processing can take additional time.
hi_journey.local_body: After the local handoff, the parcel is sorted for its delivery route and carried to the destination.
hi_journey.one_body: We follow a sample package as it leaves a warehouse, moves into dispatch, and gets ready for the journey ahead.
hi_journey.two_body: Packed and ready, the parcel travels by air before reaching its destination country for customs handling.
hi_journey.three_title:
The final stretch.
Right to the door.
hi_journey.three_body: After the local handoff, the parcel follows the final route from the delivery vehicle to the front door.
hi_journey.caption: Illustrated route · not live order tracking
hi_journey.outro_body: 2 + 7 + 2 = 11 days is an illustrative planning example, not a verified delivery estimate or guarantee. Actual processing, international transport, customs, and local delivery depend on the product, provider, and destination. Confirmed delivery information will be shown before checkout.
hi_journey.arrived: A package arrives at the doorstep.
hi_journey.disclosure: Illustrated journey. The 2 + 7 + 2 days are an example, not a confirmed arrival estimate.

bodies.preparation: In this illustrated route, the item is protected, the box is sealed and the label is applied. Preparation is part of the delivery timeline.
bodies.dispatch: The parcel leaves the packing station for dispatch. A label and a carrier handoff can happen at different times.
bodies.loading: The parcel moves into air transport in this example. The actual transport route depends on the product and destination.
bodies.ocean: International transport connects origin and destination. The total time also includes preparation, border handling and local delivery.
bodies.arrival: After landing come unloading, customs and sorting. Border processing can add time before the local carrier takes over.
bodies.truck: The parcel joins the local delivery network. The available shipment updates show where an actual order stands.
bodies.road: In the story, the delivery vehicle leaves the logistics district and follows the route into a neighborhood.
bodies.house: The courier parks, collects the illustrated parcel and carries it along the path to the front door.

about.title: Why HiParcelo
about.description: The everyday thinking behind HiParcelo: familiar hassles, useful finds and the details that help an idea fit your life.
about.copy_2: You’ve already found a way around it.
about.copy_3: You untangle the cable. Rearrange the drawer. Add one more step to a morning that already has enough of them. Nothing dramatic. Just one of those little things you’ve learned to work around.
about.copy_4: Then you see an idea and know exactly where you’d use it. You can almost picture that part of your day going differently.
about.copy_5: That quiet “oh, that would help” is the feeling behind HiParcelo.
about.copy_7: A good find starts before you find it.
about.copy_8: It starts with a job you repeat, a space that doesn’t quite work or a workaround you’ve stopped questioning. We’re interested in items with a clear place in those moments.
about.copy_10: You can picture using it. Now check the picture.
about.copy_11: The size of your shelf. What comes in the box. The materials, setup and limits. These details decide whether an appealing idea becomes something you reach for. They deserve space alongside the demonstration.
about.copy_13: The parcel is part of the purchase.
about.copy_14: So are the days before it arrives, the cost of getting it to you and knowing where to turn if something needs attention. Our first offer will bring those details together before orders open.
about.copy_16: You reach for it, it has a job to do, and you’re glad you found it.
about.copy_20: We’re preparing our first focused offer. There is nothing to order or reserve yet. Its page will bring together the actual item, the useful details and what to expect after choosing.

guides.description: Short HiParcelo guides for what arrives, the fit in your life and the first use.
guides.copy_1: You can like the idea and still have a question.
guides.copy_2: Will it fit? What comes with it? Is it simple to look after? These short guides help you bring the idea into the place you actually plan to use it.
guides.copy_4: Five answers to have before a parcel has your name on it: the contents, fit, full cost, delivery and what happens if something isn’t right.
guides.copy_5: Will it fit where I need it?

guide_before_ordering.title: What will I actually get?
guide_before_ordering.description: What arrives, whether it fits, the full cost, delivery and return details: five answers before choosing.
guide_before_ordering.copy_1: The exciting part is easy to picture.
guide_before_ordering.copy_2: You’ve seen what it could do. Now bring the rest of the picture into focus. These five answers help you understand the purchase as well as the idea.
guide_before_ordering.copy_4: Check the exact item, selected option, quantity and included pieces. Look for any accessory in the demonstration that is sold separately.
guide_before_ordering.copy_6: Match the dimensions, intended use and compatibility with the place or routine you have in mind.
guide_before_ordering.copy_8: Look at the currency, delivery charge, taxes and any separate import charges explained for your destination.
guide_before_ordering.copy_10: Read processing and delivery together. Check that the destination is supported and that the estimate applies to your order.
guide_before_ordering.copy_12: Find the return conditions, applicable rights, costs, instructions and how to contact the seller.
guide_before_ordering.copy_14: You don’t have to figure out the perfect question.

guide_fit.title: Will it fit where I need it?
guide_fit.description: Check dimensions, compatibility and your everyday routine to see whether an idea fits where you need it.
guide_fit.copy_1: Start with the place you already have.
guide_fit.copy_2: The shelf, drawer, counter or bag in a video may be different from yours. The useful question is what happens in your space, with the things you use every day.
guide_fit.copy_4: Check the available width, depth and height against the product dimensions. Allow for doors, handles, cables, moving parts or access needed to use it.
guide_fit.copy_5: Check what it needs to work with.
guide_fit.copy_6: Materials, surfaces, fixings, device models and power requirements can matter, depending on the item. Use the specifications for the exact product and option.
guide_fit.copy_8: Where would you keep it? When would you reach for it? Would setup or care fit into your routine? Those small answers help you judge the real fit.
guide_fit.copy_9: A photo can leave out a measurement.
guide_fit.copy_10: If a dimension or compatibility detail is missing,
guide_fit.copy_12: . Include the item and the place or purpose you have in mind.

guide_use_and_care.title: It’s here. Now make it useful.
guide_use_and_care.description: The steps between opening a parcel and making a useful find part of your day: setup, instructions and care.
guide_use_and_care.copy_1: Give the first use a little attention.
guide_use_and_care.copy_2: Before the item becomes part of your routine, check what arrived against the order and read the instructions for the exact product. Keep small parts and packaging away from children and pets while unpacking.
guide_use_and_care.copy_4: Check setup, intended use, compatibility and any warnings. Use the item as directed. If it appears damaged or unsafe, stop using it and ask for help.
guide_use_and_care.copy_5: Care belongs to the actual material.
guide_use_and_care.copy_6: Cleaning, storage, charging and maintenance requirements vary. Follow the product’s instructions rather than assuming that a method suitable for another item will work here.
guide_use_and_care.copy_8: Save the order confirmation and product instructions. They make it easier to identify the item if you need help later.
guide_use_and_care.copy_11: , with the order reference if you have it. A short explanation and relevant photos can help make the question clear.
